limits: No biological count matrices, sequencing reads, private arrays or model checkpoints downloaded or opened in this task.
Saved local development diagnostic JSON was read; no private assessment outcomes released.
No fitting, re-labeling, QC filtering, causal scoring, or experiment/selection changes.
Processed data availability was verified by repository metadata links; matrix content, QC, barcode pairing and checksums were not independently checked.
Sublibraries are not assumed to be independent biological replicates; individual/donor matching is not inferred from common study membership.
Paired external datasets are optional expanded evidence requiring a separate approved intake/benchmark protocol.
Unauthenticated direct browser NCBI access often returned CAPTCHA and sandbox networking had no DNS; bounded read-only network retrieval then succeeded.
